subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving validated referrals for {Brand} on a cost-per-sale basis across your desktop and mobile web journeys. The one point worth repeating: you pay only on a referral the merchant confirms and that survives the returns window, read natively through your web pixel and a server-to-server postback on the transaction ID. We are running that lane at around 6,500 validated referrals a day for UK comparison. Worth a short look at the category-level view?
register_notes: Stage 1 EN comparison_aggregator: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof from parent (validated referral via web pixel + S2S postback + returns-window confirmation); one illustrative MobUpps figure (6,500 validated referrals/day); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; British-English register, no transliteration; no sign-off; no em-dash; no X-not-Y.
